BENILLA_ALCHEMY_ART = "Interface\\Benilla\\alchemy\\" BENILLA_ALCHEMY_JOURNAL = "Interface\\Benilla\\journal\\" BENILLA_ALCHEMY_LOG_LINES = 8 BENILLA_ALCHEMY_COLUMN = 86 -- vial_glass.tga at 40 x 160: the inside the liquid fills, from the glass's bottom-left. BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GLASS = { w = 40, h = 160, left = 8, inner = 24, bottom = 8, height = 120 } -- The realm's grade names by its 0-based index (alchemy.toml [grades] names): a target -- names its grade, where AlchemyGrade carries only the index. BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GRADES = { [0] = "Minor", [1] = "Lesser", [2] = "Standard", [3] = "Greater" } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PROPS = { "Restorative", "Fortifying", "Volatile", "Arcane", "Calming" } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_COLOURS = { Restorative = { 0.910, 0.314, 0.314 }, Fortifying = { 0.941, 0.659, 0.188 }, Volatile = { 1.000, 0.478, 0.102 }, Arcane = { 0.710, 0.424, 1.000 }, Calming = { 0.247, 0.827, 0.878 }, Toxic = { 0.361, 0.839, 0.361 }, Purifying = { 0.788, 0.839, 0.871 }, } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PURIFIED = { 0.788, 0.839, 0.871 } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD = { 1.000, 0.820, 0.000 } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREEN = { 0.118, 1.000, 0.000 } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_RED = { 1.000, 0.300, 0.300 } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREY = { 0.600, 0.600, 0.600 } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_EDGE = { 0.431, 0.337, 0.161 } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PICKER = { { label = "Making · materials", x = 28, keys = { "tincture", "essence" } }, { label = "Making · consumables", x = 286, keys = { "potion", "oil", "flask" } }, } -- A dark make's tooltip: how it opens. BENILLA_ALCHEMY_OPENS = { potion = "Open from the start.", tincture = "Brew any potion to open the Still.", essence = "Distill a Tincture to condense Essences.", oil = "Distill a Tincture to open the Oil Tin.", flask = "Make an Essence to open the Flask Rack.", } -- The family a make's target comes from; the Flask has none. BENILLA_ALCHEMY_FAMILY = { potion = "potion", tincture = "tincture", essence = "essence", oil = "oil" } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_KINDS = { [0] = "Herbs", [1] = "Fish", [2] = "Tinctures", [3] = "Essences" } -- The log's colours by a made line's kind: 0 info, 1 learn, 2 say, 3 product, 4 error. BENILLA_ALCHEMY_LOG_COLOURS = { [0] = { 0.900, 0.900, 0.900 }, [1] = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD, [2] = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREY, [3] = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREEN, [4] = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_RED, } BENILLA_ALCHEMY_ERROR = 4
-- slots holds each make's list of item entries; target each make's "family|key|Grade". BenillaAlchemyState = { open = false, making = "potion", makes = {}, tray = {}, targets = {}, rumours = {}, tiers = {}, slots = {}, target = {}, last = {}, log = {}, rumour = 1, sludge = 0, cards = 0, groups = 0, }
function BenillaAlchemy_Text(parent, name, font, layer) return parent:CreateFontString(name, layer or "OVERLAY", getglobal(font) and font or nil) end
function BenillaAlchemy_Place(region, parent, x, y, w, h) region:ClearAllPoints() region:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", parent, "TOPLEFT", x, -y) if w then region:SetWidth(w) end if h then region:SetHeight(h) end end
-- A 1 px line on each edge of `frame`, in r, g, b. function BenillaAlchemy_Lines(frame, r, g, b) local points = { { "TOPLEFT", "TOPRIGHT", "height" }, { "BOTTOMLEFT", "BOTTOMRIGHT", "height" }, { "TOPLEFT", "BOTTOMLEFT", "width" }, { "TOPRIGHT", "BOTTOMRIGHT", "width" }, } local lines = {} for n, p in ipairs(points) do local line = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BORDER") line:SetTexture(r, g, b, 1) line:SetPoint(p[1], frame, p[1], 0, 0) line:SetPoint(p[2], frame, p[2], 0, 0) if p[3] == "height" then line:SetHeight(1) else line:SetWidth(1) end lines[n] = line end return lines end
function BenillaAlchemy_Colour(lines, c, a) for _, line in ipairs(lines) do line:SetTexture(c[1], c[2], c[3], a or 1) end end
-- A dark fill and a gold-dim border, as the Kitchen's chips. function BenillaAlchemy_ChipBack(frame) local bg = frame:CreateTexture(nil, "BACKGROUND") bg:SetTexture(0, 0, 0, 0.3) bg:SetAllPoints(frame) local e = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_EDGE return BenillaAlchemy_Lines(frame, e[1], e[2], e[3]) end
function BenillaAlchemy_Inset(parent, x, y, w, h) local fill = parent:CreateTexture(nil, "ARTWORK") fill:SetTexture(0.055, 0.035, 0.018, 0.65) BenillaAlchemy_Place(fill, parent, x, y, w, h) end
function BenillaAlchemy_Hex(c) return string.format("|cff%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(c[1] * 255), math.floor(c[2] * 255), math.floor(c[3] * 255)) end
function BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(c, text) return BenillaAlchemy_Hex(c) .. text .. "|r" end
function BenillaAlchemy_Grey(text) return BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREY, text) end
function BenillaAlchemy_ItemInfo(item) if not item or item == 0 then return nil end local name, _, quality, _, _, _, _, _, texture = GetItemInfo(item) return name, quality, texture end
function BenillaAlchemy_Name(item) return (BenillaAlchemy_ItemInfo(item)) or "Unknown item" end
-- An item's name and `suffix` in its quality colour. function BenillaAlchemy_Coloured(item, suffix) local name, quality = BenillaAlchemy_ItemInfo(item) local colour = ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS and ITEM_QUALITY_COLORS[quality or 1] local c = colour and { colour.r, colour.g, colour.b } or { 1, 1, 1 } return BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(c, (name or "Unknown item") .. (suffix or "")) end
-- Points as the prototype prints them: "4", "6.25". function BenillaAlchemy_Points(v) v = v or 0 if math.floor(v) == v then return string.format("%d", v) end local s = string.format("%.2f", v) s = string.gsub(s, "0+$", "") s = string.gsub(s, "%.$", "") return s end
-- "Restorative" -> "Rest", "Toxic" -> "Tox", "Purifying" -> "Pure". function BenillaAlchemy_Short(prop) if prop == "Toxic" then return "Tox" end if prop == "Purifying" then return "Pure" end return string.sub(prop, 1, 4) end
-- "Standard" is the plain grade. function BenillaAlchemy_Plain(grade) if grade == "Standard" then return "plain" end return grade end
function BenillaAlchemy_Money(copper) local g, s = math.floor(copper / 10000), math.mod(math.floor(copper / 100), 100) return (g > 0 and (g .. "g ") or "") .. s .. "s" end
-- ---------- state ----------
-- The open table's makes, tray, targets, Rumours and tiers, read into Lua tables. function BenillaAlchemy_Load() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local _, _, _, numMakes, numTray, numTargets, numRumours, sludge = GetAlchemyBench() st.makes, st.tray, st.targets, st.rumours, st.tiers = {}, {}, {}, {}, {} for i = 1, numMakes or 0 do local key, name, station, verb, rule, open, herbsMin, herbsMax, tinctures, essences, fish, wash = GetAlchemyMake(i) st.makes[i] = { key = key, name = name, station = station, verb = verb, rule = rule, open = open, herbsMin = herbsMin, herbsMax = herbsMax, tinctures = tinctures, essences = essences, fish = fish, wash = wash } end for i = 1, numTray or 0 do local item, count, kind, level, numValues, prop, points, toxic, step = GetAlchemyTrayItem(i) local values = {} for j = 1, numValues do local name, pts = GetAlchemyTrayValue(i, j) values[j] = { name = name, points = pts } end st.tray[i] = { item = item, count = count, kind = kind, level = level, values = values, prop = prop, points = points, toxic = toxic, step = step } end for i = 1, numTargets or 0 do local family, key, grade, name, learned, rumoured, threshold = GetAlchemyTarget(i) st.targets[i] = { family = family, key = key, grade = grade, name = name, learned = learned, rumoured = rumoured, threshold = threshold } end for i = 1, numRumours or 0 do local family, key, grade, name, price = GetAlchemyRumour(i) st.rumours[i] = { family = family, key = key, grade = grade, name = name, price = price } end local i = 1 while GetAlchemyTier(i) do st.tiers[i] = GetAlchemyTier(i) i = i + 1 end st.sludge = sludge or 0 if st.rumour > table.getn(st.rumours) then st.rumour = 1 end end
function BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(key) for _, m in ipairs(BenillaAlchemyState.makes) do if m.key == key then return m end end return nil end
function BenillaAlchemy_TrayOf(item) for _, t in ipairs(BenillaAlchemyState.tray) do if t.item == item then return t end end return nil end
-- The picked make's list. function BenillaAlchemy_List() local st = BenillaAlchemyState if not st.slots[st.making] then st.slots[st.making] = {} end return st.slots[st.making] end
function BenillaAlchemy_Used(list, item) local used = 0 for _, s in ipairs(list) do if s == item then used = used + 1 end end return used end
-- How many of a kind the make takes (the prototype's `accepts`). function BenillaAlchemy_Accepts(m, kind) if kind == 0 then return math.max(m.herbsMax, m.wash) end if kind == 1 then return m.fish end if kind == 2 then return m.tinctures end if kind == 3 then return m.essences end return 0 end
-- How many more of `item` the picked make has room for (the prototype's `room`). function BenillaAlchemy_Room(item) local st = BenillaAlchemyState local m, t = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(st.making), BenillaAlchemy_TrayOf(item) if not m or not t or not m.open then return 0 end local list = BenillaAlchemy_List() local ofKind = 0 for _, s in ipairs(list) do local o = BenillaAlchemy_TrayOf(s) if o and o.kind == t.kind then ofKind = ofKind + 1 end end local cap = BenillaAlchemy_Accepts(m, t.kind) - ofKind return math.max(0, math.min(cap, t.count - BenillaAlchemy_Used(list, item))) end
function BenillaAlchemy_TargetKey(t) return t.family .. "|" .. t.key .. "|" .. (BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GRADES[t.grade] or "") end
function BenillaAlchemy_TargetOf(key) for i, t in ipairs(BenillaAlchemyState.targets) do if BenillaAlchemy_TargetKey(t) == key then return t, i end end return nil end
function BenillaAlchemy_Preview() local st = BenillaAlchemyState st.waiting = true AlchemyPreview(st.making, st.target[st.making] or "", unpack(BenillaAlchemy_List())) end
-- The list, the target or the make changed: the result goes, the realm is asked again. function BenillaAlchemy_Changed() local st = BenillaAlchemyState if st.result == st.making then st.result = nil end BenillaAlchemy_Preview() BenillaAlchemy_Paint() end
function BenillaAlchemy_Log(kind, text) local log = BenillaAlchemyState.log table.insert(log, { kind = kind, text = text }) while table.getn(log) > BENILLA_ALCHEMY_LOG_LINES do table.remove(log, 1) end end
-- Drops what the player no longer holds from every list; true when the picked one changed. function BenillaAlchemy_DropMissing() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local changed = false for make, list in pairs(st.slots) do local kept, used = {}, {} for _, item in ipairs(list) do used[item] = (used[item] or 0) + 1 local t = BenillaAlchemy_TrayOf(item) if t and t.count >= used[item] then table.insert(kept, item) elseif make == st.making then changed = true end end st.slots[make] = kept end return changed end
-- ---------- actions ----------
function BenillaAlchemy_Pick(key) local m = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(key) if not m or not m.open then return end BenillaAlchemyState.making = key BenillaAlchemy_Preview() BenillaAlchemy_Paint() end
-- Adds up to `n` of `item` to the picked make's list, or says why none fit. function BenillaAlchemy_Add(item, n) local st = BenillaAlchemyState local m, t = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(st.making), BenillaAlchemy_TrayOf(item) if not m or not t then return end local list = BenillaAlchemy_List() local add = math.min(BenillaAlchemy_Room(item), n) if add > 0 then for _ = 1, add do table.insert(list, item) end BenillaAlchemy_Changed() return end local text if BenillaAlchemy_Accepts(m, t.kind) == 0 then text = "A " .. m.name .. " does not take " .. string.lower(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_KINDS[t.kind] or "that") .. "." elseif t.count <= BenillaAlchemy_Used(list, item) then text = "No " .. BenillaAlchemy_Name(item) .. " left to add." else text = "The " .. m.station .. " is full." end BenillaAlchemy_Log(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_ERROR, text) BenillaAlchemy_PaintLog() end
-- Takes one `item` out of the picked make's list. function BenillaAlchemy_Less(item) local list = BenillaAlchemy_List() for j = table.getn(list), 1, -1 do if list[j] == item then table.remove(list, j) BenillaAlchemy_Changed() return end end end
function BenillaAlchemy_Clear() local st = BenillaAlchemyState st.slots[st.making] = {} BenillaAlchemy_Changed() end
-- The last list made at this make again, or why it cannot be. function BenillaAlchemy_Again() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local last = st.last[st.making] if not last then return end local need, order = {}, {} for _, item in ipairs(last) do if not need[item] then table.insert(order, item) end need[item] = (need[item] or 0) + 1 end for _, item in ipairs(order) do local t = BenillaAlchemy_TrayOf(item) local have = t and t.count or 0 if have < need[item] then BenillaAlchemy_Log(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_ERROR, "Not enough " .. BenillaAlchemy_Name(item) .. " for that again (" .. have .. " of " .. need[item] .. ").") BenillaAlchemy_PaintLog() return end end local list = {} for j, item in ipairs(last) do list[j] = item end st.slots[st.making] = list BenillaAlchemy_Changed() end
-- The target of `family`'s `key` at the 0-based `grade`, which also picks its make; nil -- family for none. The target dropdown's entries call this, and so does the Alchemy -- Journal's "Make this". function BenillaAlchemy_SetTarget(family, key, grade) local st = BenillaAlchemyState if not family or family == "" then st.target[st.making] = nil else local make = family == "hybrid" and "potion" or family local m = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(make) if not m or not m.open or not BENILLA_ALCHEMY_FAMILY[make] then return end st.target[make] = family .. "|" .. key .. "|" .. (BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GRADES[grade] or "") st.making = make end BenillaAlchemy_Changed() end
function BenillaAlchemy_SetRumour(i) BenillaAlchemyState.rumour = i BenillaAlchemy_PaintShop() end
function BenillaAlchemyGo_OnClick() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local ready = GetAlchemyPreview() if not ready or st.waiting then return end local list = BenillaAlchemy_List() local items = {} for j, item in ipairs(list) do items[j] = item end st.pending = { make = st.making, items = items } st.waiting = true AlchemyMake(st.making, st.target[st.making] or "", unpack(items)) BenillaAlchemy_PaintControls() end
function BenillaAlchemyBuy_OnClick() local r = BenillaAlchemyState.rumours[BenillaAlchemyState.rumour] if r then AlchemyBuyRumour(r.family, r.key, r.grade) end end
function BenillaAlchemyPick_OnClick() BenillaAlchemy_Pick(this.key) end
function BenillaAlchemyPick_OnEnter() local m = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(this.key) if not m or not GameTooltip then return end GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_BOTTOM") if m.open then GameTooltip:SetText(m.rule .. " at the " .. m.station) else GameTooltip:SetText(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_OPENS[m.key] or "") end GameTooltip:Show() end
function BenillaAlchemyCard_OnClick() BenillaAlchemy_Add(this.item, 1) end
function BenillaAlchemy_ItemTip(item) if item and item ~= 0 and GameTooltip then GameTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink("item:" .. item .. ":0:0:0") GameTooltip:Show() end end
function BenillaAlchemy_HideTip() if GameTooltip then GameTooltip:Hide() end end
-- ---------- the dropdowns (the 1.12 UIDropDownMenu kit) ----------
function BenillaAlchemy_NoTarget(make) return "Target: none (most points wins" .. (make == "potion" and "; a hybrid forms when two properties clear its ladder" or "") .. ")" end
function BenillaAlchemy_TargetText(t) local tail = "" if not t.learned then tail = t.rumoured and " (rumour)" or " (?)" end return "Target: " .. t.name .. tail end
function BenillaAlchemy_RumourText(r) return r.name .. " — " .. BenillaAlchemy_Money(r.price) end
function BenillaAlchemy_MenuArrow(text, value, level) local info = {} info.text = text info.value = value info.hasArrow = 1 UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info, level) end
-- Level 1: none, then the family's grades; the Potion's go under "Single potions" and -- "Hybrid potions", and the hybrids under their grade, since a list holds 32 buttons. function BenillaAlchemyTarget_Init() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local level = UIDROPDOWNMENU_MENU_LEVEL or 1 local make = st.making local family = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_FAMILY[make] if not family then return end local function entry(i, t) local info = {} info.text = BenillaAlchemy_TargetText(t) info.value = i info.func = BenillaAlchemyTarget_OnClick if st.target[make] == BenillaAlchemy_TargetKey(t) then info.checked = 1 end UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info, level) end local value = UIDROPDOWNMENU_MENU_VALUE if level == 1 then local info = {} info.text = BenillaAlchemy_NoTarget(make) info.value = 0 info.func = BenillaAlchemyTarget_OnClick if not st.target[make] then info.checked = 1 end UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info, level) if make == "potion" then BenillaAlchemy_MenuArrow("Single potions", "single", level) BenillaAlchemy_MenuArrow("Hybrid potions", "hybrid", level) return end for i, t in ipairs(st.targets) do if t.family == family then entry(i, t) end end elseif level == 2 and value == "single" then for i, t in ipairs(st.targets) do if t.family == "potion" then entry(i, t) end end elseif level == 2 and value == "hybrid" then for g = 0, 3 do BenillaAlchemy_MenuArrow(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GRADES[g], g, level) end elseif level == 3 then for i, t in ipairs(st.targets) do if t.family == "hybrid" and t.grade == value then entry(i, t) end end end end
function BenillaAlchemyTarget_OnClick() local t = BenillaAlchemyState.targets[this.value] if t then BenillaAlchemy_SetTarget(t.family, t.key, t.grade) else BenillaAlchemy_SetTarget(nil) end if CloseDropDownMenus then CloseDropDownMenus() end end
-- Every Rumour in one list, or under its grade when they pass a list's 32 buttons. function BenillaAlchemyRumour_Init() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local level = UIDROPDOWNMENU_MENU_LEVEL or 1 local grouped = table.getn(st.rumours) > 30 local function entry(i, r) local info = {} info.text = BenillaAlchemy_RumourText(r) info.value = i info.func = BenillaAlchemyRumour_OnClick if st.rumour == i then info.checked = 1 end UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info, level) end if level == 1 and not grouped then for i, r in ipairs(st.rumours) do entry(i, r) end elseif level == 1 then for g = 0, 3 do for _, r in ipairs(st.rumours) do if r.grade == g then BenillaAlchemy_MenuArrow(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GRADES[g], g, level) break end end end elseif level == 2 then for i, r in ipairs(st.rumours) do if r.grade == UIDROPDOWNMENU_MENU_VALUE then entry(i, r) end end end end
function BenillaAlchemyRumour_OnClick() BenillaAlchemy_SetRumour(this.value) if CloseDropDownMenus then CloseDropDownMenus() end end
-- ---------- painting ----------
function BenillaAlchemy_PaintPicker() local st = BenillaAlchemyState for i = 1, 5 do local b = getglobal("BenillaAlchemyMake" .. i) local m = st.makes[i] if m then b.key = m.key local name, station = getglobal(b:GetName() .. "Name"), getglobal(b:GetName() .. "Station") name:SetText(m.name) if m.open then station:SetText(m.station) name:SetTextColor(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD[1], BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD[2], BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD[3]) b:Enable() b:SetAlpha(1) else station:SetText("Dark") local g = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREY name:SetTextColor(g[1], g[2], g[3]) b:Disable() b:SetAlpha(0.6) end BenillaAlchemy_Colour(b.edge, m.key == st.making and BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD or BENILLA_ALCHEMY_EDGE) b:Show() else b:Hide() end end -- Each group's buttons from its left edge, in the group's own order. for _, group in ipairs(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PICKER) do local x = group.x for _, key in ipairs(group.keys) do for i = 1, 5 do local m = st.makes[i] if m and m.key == key then BenillaAlchemy_Place(getglobal("BenillaAlchemyMake" .. i), BenillaAlchemy, x, 72) x = x + 118 end end end end end
function BenillaAlchemy_PaintWork() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local m = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(st.making) if not m then BenillaAlchemyStation:SetText("") BenillaAlchemyRule:SetText("") return end BenillaAlchemyStation:SetText(m.station) if m.open then BenillaAlchemyRule:SetText(m.name .. " · " .. m.rule) else BenillaAlchemyRule:SetText(m.name .. "s are dark. " .. (BENILLA_ALCHEMY_OPENS[m.key] or "")) end end
-- One vial's height on the glass for `v` points. function BenillaAlchemy_Height(v, scale) if not scale or scale <= 0 or not v or v <= 0 then return 0 end return BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GLASS.height * math.min(1, v / scale) end
-- A layer on vial `col` from `bottom` up `h`, tinted `c` at alpha `a`; hidden when empty. function BenillaAlchemy_Layer(tex, col, bottom, h, c, a) local g = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GLASS h = math.min(h, g.height - bottom) if h < 0.5 then tex:Hide() return 0 end tex:ClearAllPoints() tex:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", col.glass, "BOTTOMLEFT", g.left, g.bottom + bottom) tex:SetWidth(g.inner) tex:SetHeight(h) tex:SetVertexColor(c[1], c[2], c[3], a) tex:Show() return h end
-- Paints vial `n`: `v` holds prop, value, unknown, main, target, bonus, tick and, on the -- Toxic vial, purified; `rings` the ladder; `note` the line under it. function BenillaAlchemy_PaintVial(n, v, scale, rings, note) local col = getglobal("BenillaAlchemyVial" .. n) local g = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GLASS local c = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_COLOURS[v.prop] or { 1, 1, 1 } local up = BenillaAlchemy_Layer(col.liquid, col, 0, BenillaAlchemy_Height(v.value, scale), c, 1) up = up + BenillaAlchemy_Layer(col.bonus, col, up, BenillaAlchemy_Height(v.bonus, scale), c, 0.5) up = up + BenillaAlchemy_Layer(col.purified, col, up, BenillaAlchemy_Height(v.purified, scale), BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PURIFIED, 0.85) local tickOnRing = false for r = 1, 4 do local ring, label = col.rings[r], col.labels[r] local value = rings[r] or 0 if value > 0 and scale and scale > 0 and value <= scale then local gold = v.tick and v.tick > 0 and v.tick == value tickOnRing = tickOnRing or gold local rc = gold and BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GOLD or { 1, 1, 1 } ring:SetTexture(rc[1], rc[2], rc[3], gold and 1 or 0.45) ring:ClearAllPoints() ring:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", col.glass, "BOTTOMLEFT", g.left - 4, g.bottom + BenillaAlchemy_Height(value, scale)) ring:SetWidth(g.inner + 8) ring:SetHeight(1) ring:Show() label:SetText(tostring(value)) label:Show() else ring:Hide() label:Hide() end end if v.tick and v.tick > 0 and not tickOnRing and scale and scale > 0 then col.tick:ClearAllPoints() col.tick:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", col.glass, "BOTTOMLEFT", g.left - 4, g.bottom + BenillaAlchemy_Height(v.tick, scale)) col.tick:SetWidth(g.inner + 8) col.tick:SetHeight(2) col.tick:Show() col.tickLabel:SetText(tostring(v.tick)) col.tickLabel:Show() else col.tick:Hide() col.tickLabel:Hide() end if v.unknown then col.q:ClearAllPoints() col.q:SetPoint("BOTTOM", col.glass, "BOTTOMLEFT", g.left + g.inner / 2, g.bottom + math.min(up, g.height - 12) + 2) col.q:Show() else col.q:Hide() end if v.main then col.glow:SetTexture(c[1], c[2], c[3], 0.28) col.glow:Show() else col.glow:Hide() end col.name:SetText(v.prop) col.name:SetTextColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) local text if v.value and v.value > 0 then text = BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(c, BenillaAlchemy_Points(v.value)) elseif v.unknown then text = "?" else text = BenillaAlchemy_Grey("–") end if v.bonus and v.bonus > 0 then text = text .. " " .. BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(c, "+" .. BenillaAlchemy_Points(v.bonus)) end col.value:SetText(text) col.note:SetText(note or "") end
-- The result's name from its product line ("Minor Healing Potion x1, into your bags."), -- else the made item's name. function BenillaAlchemy_ResultName(product, numLines) for i = 1, numLines do local kind, text = GetAlchemyMadeLine(i) if kind == 3 then local _, _, name = string.find(text, "^(.-), into your bags") if name then name = string.gsub(name, " carrying Toxic ", " · Toxic ") return name end end end local name = BenillaAlchemy_ItemInfo(product) if name then return name end for i = 1, numLines do local kind, text = GetAlchemyMadeLine(i) if kind == 2 then local _, _, first = string.find(text, "^(.-)%.") if first then return first end end end return "" end
-- The line under the first main vial: the product and its step in its quality colour, -- "Something new", Murky Sludge, or why the list is not ready. function BenillaAlchemy_ProductLine() local ready, note, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, known, product, sludge, carried = GetAlchemyPreview() if ready == nil then return "" end if not ready then return BenillaAlchemy_Grey(note) end if sludge then return BenillaAlchemy_Grey("Murky Sludge") end if known and product ~= 0 then local step = GetAlchemyItemStep(product) local line = BenillaAlchemy_Coloured(product, step and (" " .. step) or "") if carried and carried > 0 then line = line .. BenillaAlchemy_Grey(" · carries Toxic " .. carried) end return line end return BenillaAlchemy_Grey("Something new") end
function BenillaAlchemy_PaintVials() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local made = st.result ~= nil and st.result == st.making local scale, rings, getVial, getToxic, footer, resultName local ready, note, unnoted, failed, failPct if made then local product, f, pct, numLines, s, r1, r2, r3, r4 = GetAlchemyMade() scale, rings, failed, failPct = s, { r1, r2, r3, r4 }, f, pct getVial, getToxic = GetAlchemyMadeVial, GetAlchemyMadeToxic resultName = BenillaAlchemy_ResultName(product or 0, numLines or 0) footer = "Result · " .. resultName BenillaAlchemy_Colour(BenillaAlchemyVials.edge, failed and BENILLA_ALCHEMY_RED or BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREEN) for _, line in ipairs(BenillaAlchemyVials.edge) do line:Show() end else local s, r1, r2, r3, r4 ready, note, unnoted, s, r1, r2, r3, r4 = GetAlchemyPreview() scale, rings = s, { r1, r2, r3, r4 } getVial, getToxic = GetAlchemyPreviewVial, GetAlchemyPreviewToxic for _, line in ipairs(BenillaAlchemyVials.edge) do line:Hide() end if unnoted and unnoted > 0 then footer = BenillaAlchemy_Grey(unnoted .. (unnoted == 1 and " unnoted herb" or " unnoted herbs") .. " not shown") end end local vials, firstMain = {}, nil for i = 1, 5 do local prop, value, unknown, main, isTarget, bonus, tick = getVial(i) vials[i] = { prop = prop or BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PROPS[i], value = value or 0, unknown = unknown and unknown > 0, main = main, target = isTarget, bonus = bonus or 0, tick = tick or 0 } if main and not firstMain then firstMain = i end end for i = 1, 5 do local v, line = vials[i], nil if i == firstMain then if made then line = failed and BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_RED, "Murky Sludge") or BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREEN, resultName) else line = BenillaAlchemy_ProductLine() end elseif v.target and v.tick > 0 and not v.main then line = BenillaAlchemy_Grey("target ≥ " .. v.tick) elseif not firstMain and i == 1 and not made and ready == false then line = BenillaAlchemy_Grey(note) end BenillaAlchemy_PaintVial(i, v, scale, rings, line) end local raw, purify, net, unknown, pct = getToxic() raw, purify, net = raw or 0, purify or 0, net or 0 local toxNote if made and failed then toxNote = BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_RED, "failed") elseif net > 0 then toxNote = BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_RED, (pct or failPct or 0) .. "% fail") elseif raw > 0 then toxNote = BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PURIFIED, "purified") elseif unknown then toxNote = BenillaAlchemy_Grey("unknown") else toxNote = BenillaAlchemy_Grey("no roll") end BenillaAlchemy_PaintVial(6, { prop = "Toxic", value = net, unknown = unknown, purified = math.min(raw, purify), bonus = 0, tick = 0 }, scale, rings, toxNote) BenillaAlchemyFooter:SetText(footer or "") end
function BenillaAlchemy_PaintControls() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local m = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(st.making) local list = BenillaAlchemy_List() local ready = GetAlchemyPreview() BenillaAlchemyGo:SetText(m and m.verb or "") if m and m.open and ready and not st.waiting and st.result ~= st.making then BenillaAlchemyGo:Enable() else BenillaAlchemyGo:Disable() end if st.last[st.making] then BenillaAlchemyAgain:Show() else BenillaAlchemyAgain:Hide() end if table.getn(list) > 0 then BenillaAlchemyClear:Show() else BenillaAlchemyClear:Hide() end local family = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_FAMILY[st.making] if not family then BenillaAlchemyTarget:Hide() return end BenillaAlchemyTarget:Show() if UIDropDownMenu_SetText then local t = st.target[st.making] and BenillaAlchemy_TargetOf(st.target[st.making]) UIDropDownMenu_SetText(t and BenillaAlchemy_TargetText(t) or BenillaAlchemy_NoTarget(st.making), BenillaAlchemyTarget) end end
-- A herb's known values as chips ("Rest 2 Tox 1", "Rest ?"), or a Tincture's or Essence's -- Toxic. function BenillaAlchemy_Chips(t) if t.kind == 0 then if table.getn(t.values) == 0 then return BenillaAlchemy_Grey("unknown") end local out = {} for _, v in ipairs(t.values) do local c = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_COLOURS[v.name] or { 1, 1, 1 } local pts = v.points and BenillaAlchemy_Points(v.points) or "?" table.insert(out, BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(c, BenillaAlchemy_Short(v.name) .. " " .. pts)) end return table.concat(out, " ") end if t.kind == 2 or t.kind == 3 then if t.toxic > 0 then return BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_COLOURS.Toxic, "Tox " .. t.toxic) end return BenillaAlchemy_Paint_Text(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_PURIFIED, "clean") end return "" end
function BenillaAlchemy_Pooled(kind, prefix, n, parent, template) local frame = getglobal(prefix .. n) if not frame then frame = CreateFrame(kind, prefix .. n, parent, template) BenillaAlchemy_ChipBack(frame) getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Slot"):SetTexture(BENILLA_ALCHEMY_JOURNAL .. "slot") end return frame end
-- The tray: the materials the picked make takes, in groups; a herb body lists Herbs first. function BenillaAlchemy_PaintTray() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local m = BenillaAlchemy_MakeOf(st.making) local child = BenillaAlchemyTrayChild local list = BenillaAlchemy_List() local y, cards, groups = 0, 0, 0 if m and m.open then local herbBody = m.herbsMax > 0 local kinds = herbBody and { 0, 2, 3, 1 } or { 2, 3, 1, 0 } for _, kind in ipairs(kinds) do local items = {} if BenillaAlchemy_Accepts(m, kind) > 0 then for _, t in ipairs(st.tray) do if t.kind == kind then table.insert(items, t) end end end if table.getn(items) > 0 then groups = groups + 1 local label = getglobal("BenillaAlchemyTrayGroup" .. groups) if not label then label = BenillaAlchemy_Text(child, "BenillaAlchemyTrayGroup" .. groups, "GameFontNormalSmall") label:SetJustifyH("LEFT") label:SetWidth(500) end label:ClearAllPoints() label:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", 2, -y) local text = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_KINDS[kind] if kind == 0 and not herbBody then text = text .. " " .. BenillaAlchemy_Grey("as a wash: only Toxic and Purifying count") elseif kind == 1 then text = text .. " " .. BenillaAlchemy_Grey("two, any kind") end label:SetText(text) label:Show() y = y + 16 for n, t in ipairs(items) do cards = cards + 1 local b = BenillaAlchemy_Pooled("Button", "BenillaAlchemyTray", cards, child, "BenillaAlchemyCardTemplate") local colIndex = math.mod(n - 1, 2) b:ClearAllPoints() b:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", child, "TOPLEFT", colIndex * 256, -y) if colIndex == 1 or n == table.getn(items) then y = y + 44 end b.item = t.item local name = b:GetName() local _, _, texture = BenillaAlchemy_ItemInfo(t.item) getglobal(name .. "Icon"):SetTexture(texture) local step = "" if (t.kind == 2 or t.kind == 3) and t.step > 0 then step = " x" .. BenillaAlchemy_Points(t.step) end getglobal(name .. "Name"):SetText(BenillaAlchemy_Coloured(t.item, step)) local used = BenillaAlchemy_Used(list, t.item) getglobal(name .. "Count"):SetText("× " .. (t.count - used)) getglobal(name .. "Chips"):SetText(BenillaAlchemy_Chips(t)) local room = BenillaAlchemy_Room(t.item) local inText, less, fill = getglobal(name .. "In"), getglobal(name .. "Less"), getglobal(name .. "Fill") less.item, fill.item = t.item, t.item if used > 0 then inText:SetText(used .. " in") inText:Show() less:Show() fill:Hide() else inText:Hide() less:Hide() if room > 1 then fill:SetText("+" .. room) fill:Show() else fill:Hide() end end if room > 0 then b:Enable() getglobal(name .. "Icon"):SetAlpha(1) else b:Disable() getglobal(name .. "Icon"):SetAlpha(0.5) end b:Show() end y = y + 4 end end end for n = cards + 1, st.cards do getglobal("BenillaAlchemyTray" .. n):Hide() end for n = groups + 1, st.groups do getglobal("BenillaAlchemyTrayGroup" .. n):Hide() end st.cards = math.max(cards, st.cards) st.groups = math.max(groups, st.groups) if cards == 0 and m then BenillaAlchemyTrayEmpty:SetText("Nothing in your bags that a " .. m.name .. " takes.") BenillaAlchemyTrayEmpty:Show() else BenillaAlchemyTrayEmpty:Hide() end child:SetHeight(math.max(y, 1)) BenillaAlchemyTrayScroll:UpdateScrollChildRect() end
function BenillaAlchemy_PaintShop() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local _, alchemist, line = GetAlchemyBench() alchemist = alchemist or "" BenillaAlchemySay:SetText(alchemist .. ": " .. BenillaAlchemy_Grey(line or "")) local r = st.rumours[st.rumour] if r then BenillaAlchemyRumour:Show() BenillaAlchemyBuy:Show() BenillaAlchemyNoRumours:Hide() if UIDropDownMenu_SetText then UIDropDownMenu_SetText(BenillaAlchemy_RumourText(r), BenillaAlchemyRumour) end else BenillaAlchemyRumour:Hide() BenillaAlchemyBuy:Hide() BenillaAlchemyNoRumours:Show() end local tiers = {} for i, t in ipairs(st.tiers) do tiers[i] = BenillaAlchemy_Plain(t) end BenillaAlchemyRumourHint:SetText("A Rumour gives one grade's exact threshold. " .. alchemist .. " knows the " .. table.concat(tiers, ", ") .. " grades.") if st.sludge > 0 then BenillaAlchemySell:SetText("Sell Murky Sludge (" .. st.sludge .. ")") BenillaAlchemySell:Show() else BenillaAlchemySell:Hide() end end
function BenillaAlchemy_PaintLog() local log = BenillaAlchemyState.log local n = table.getn(log) for i = 1, BENILLA_ALCHEMY_LOG_LINES do local text = getglobal("BenillaAlchemyLog" .. i) local entry = log[i] if entry then local c = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_LOG_COLOURS[entry.kind] or BENILLA_ALCHEMY_LOG_COLOURS[0] text:SetText(entry.text) text:SetTextColor(c[1], c[2], c[3]) elseif i == 1 and n == 0 then local g = BENILLA_ALCHEMY_GREY text:SetText("Pick what to make, then click materials in the tray.") text:SetTextColor(g[1], g[2], g[3]) else text:SetText("") end end end
function BenillaAlchemy_Paint() BenillaAlchemy_PaintPicker() BenillaAlchemy_PaintWork() BenillaAlchemy_PaintVials() BenillaAlchemy_PaintControls() BenillaAlchemy_PaintTray() BenillaAlchemy_PaintShop() BenillaAlchemy_PaintLog() end
-- ---------- events ----------
function BenillaAlchemy_Update() local name, alchemist = GetAlchemyBench() if not name then return end BenillaAlchemy_Fit() local st = BenillaAlchemyState BenillaAlchemy_Load() BenillaAlchemyTitle:SetText(name) BenillaAlchemySub:SetText(alchemist .. "'s table") if not st.open then st.open = true st.making = "potion" st.slots, st.target, st.last, st.log = {}, {}, {}, {} st.result, st.pending, st.rumour = nil, nil, 1 BenillaAlchemy:Show() BenillaAlchemy_Preview() elseif BenillaAlchemy_DropMissing() then BenillaAlchemy_Preview() end BenillaAlchemy_Paint() end
function BenillaAlchemy_PreviewArrived() BenillaAlchemyState.waiting = false BenillaAlchemy_PaintVials() BenillaAlchemy_PaintControls() end
-- A make's result: its lines go to the log; a made product clears the list and shows on -- the vials until the list, the target or the make changes. function BenillaAlchemy_Made() local st = BenillaAlchemyState local product, _, _, numLines = GetAlchemyMade() if not product then return end for i = 1, numLines do local kind, text = GetAlchemyMadeLine(i) BenillaAlchemy_Log(kind, text) end local pending = st.pending st.pending = nil st.waiting = false if product ~= 0 then local make = pending and pending.make or st.making if pending then st.last[make] = pending.items end st.slots[make] = {} st.result = make if make == st.making then BenillaAlchemy_Preview() end end BenillaAlchemy_Paint() end
function BenillaAlchemy_Closed() BenillaAlchemyState.open = false BenillaAlchemy:Hide() end
-- The window hidden by Escape or the close button: the realm closes the table. function BenillaAlchemy_OnHide() if BenillaAlchemyState.open then BenillaAlchemyState.open = false AlchemyClose() end end
function BenillaAlchemy_Wheel(scroll, delta) local v = scroll:GetVerticalScroll() - delta * 40 local range = scroll:GetVerticalScrollRange() if v > range then v = range end if v < 0 then v = 0 end scroll:SetVerticalScroll(v) end
